candidate: Procyon lotor site-period re-detection in the Rhode Island statewide camera survey, 2018-2023

selection_boundary.ci_sync_note: no scientific change; synchronization commit after PR creation

focal_taxon.selection_rule: first species listed in the pre-existing urban-adapted-omnivore group in the published Rhode Island camera-study methods; fixed without consulting detection counts or EOG outcomes

scientific_anchor.published_design: 249 primary survey sites over 12 survey periods from 2018 through 2023; deployment table carries camera operation dates and coordinates; detection table carries animal records with matching site/camera identifiers
scientific_anchor.endpoint: site-period raccoon re-detection among response-independently active deployments; this is surveyed detection/non-detection, not latent biological occupancy or colonization

archive_contract.member_path_resolution_note: The first central-directory-only run opened 189 ZIP metadata bytes and zero member payload bytes, revealing that both predeclared basenames are wrapped by the same DataS1/ directory. Exact wrapper-qualified paths are frozen here before any deployment or detection payload access; no file, dataset, endpoint, node rule, threshold, split, learner or response semantic changed.

deployment_semantics.site_coordinate_rule: component-wise median latitude/longitude across every response-independent deployment row assigned to the Site
deployment_semantics.site_period_effort_rule: merge inclusive active-date intervals across cameras within Site x YearSeason; eligible when union active days >= 14

structural_gate.distance: great-circle haversine using Earth radius 6371.0088 km

source_process_boundary.internal_sources: previous-period observed raccoon detections at eligible sites
source_process_boundary.external_source_requirement: finite world universe must include a permissive external/long-distance source world because immigration from outside Rhode Island cannot be closed by the camera network
source_process_boundary.interpretation: the permissive external world closes the declared possibility set; it is not asserted to be the true movement process
